violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2705(10))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device
violation_type.typical_finding: A child was placed in a restrictive device for more than an hour.

finding_variants.text: A child was placed in a restrictive device for more than an hour.
Based on the information provided, there is a video that shows a 5 year old, placed in a high chair as a form of discipline.

During the course of the investigation, it was found that caregiver's inappropriately discipline children at the operation by making them "fly". Flying is when a child has to remain silent or inactive for inappropriately long periods of time for the child?s age.
Children were observed sitting down without being given an alternate activity for an extended amount of time.
The assistant caregiver was observed telling the children to behave and if not she would put them in a high chair for acting like a baby.
A child was placed in a restrictive device for more than an hour during naptime.
